reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good coaching and clean college.

review_content.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students from our course were placed through campus recruitment drives. Highest package is 20 LPA. Lowest package is 5 LPA. Around 70%-75% of students secure an internship through campus drives. Top roles offered are software development engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel has clean and well-maintained rooms, a common study hall, and a 24/7 water and electricity supply. Mess provides balanced diet food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports. Medical, 24/7 ambulance service.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Excellent infrastructure with supportive faculty and good placements.

review_content.Placements: I am part of the 2024 to 2028 batch. My seniors who passed away from this college received many packages mentioned below. Placement Percentage around 80 to 90% of students are placed from our course. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, HCL, and a few product based companies. Internship Opportunities Nearly 70 to 80% of students got internships, often in companies like TCS, Infosys, Startups, and local IT firms, which provided good exposure. The major roles offered are Software Developer, Analyst, Associate Engineer, System Engineer, Data Analyst, and Support Engineer.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Information about Sri Ramachandra life.

review_content.Placements: Our college offers 100% placements to eligible students. The average package offered is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. The college has a dedicated placement team. The college organizes on-campus events to help students find jobs and internships. The college has a strong placement network.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the largest medical libraries in the region, and collaborates with Harvard Medical International. It has a large collection of textbooks, journals, and more. We also have modern laboratories. It also exercises physiology labs with metabolic analyzers, treadmills, and more. There is a sports biomechanics lab with 3D cameras, forceplates, and more. We have a podiatry lab with foot pressure analysis systems. There is an anthropometry lab with stadiometers and more.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities with experienced faculty.

review_content.Placements: Our college is giving 100% placement offers for eligible students. The average package offered in our college is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. Recently, a final year student got an internship offer from Amazon with a 1,10,000/- stipend. Roles offered in this course are AML analyst, ML engineer, KYC analyst, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have individual labs for each course with PCs and Wi-Fi facilities. We have a subject-concentrated library in our block with PCs and facilities. We also have individual classes for each batch of students with different courses. We have vast hostel blocks where thousands of students stay in individual hostels for boys and girls. We have 4 major canteens in our college, where we can get good food with many varieties, and we have a mess too for boys and girls. Ramachandra has vast infrastructure for sports and games, for example, our college has courts for basketball, volleyball, football, tennis, soccer, and a cricket ground.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. Computer Science and Medical Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research.

review_content.Placements: We have enormous placement opportunities in core jobs, non-core jobs, and the banking sector. They also support our ideas in startups and entrepreneurship. We had a 100% placement rate for the previous academic year, 2023. We have plenty of opportunities through on-campus drives.
review_content.Infrastructure: Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research is a large institute that supports various courses across different streams. It has a hygienic campus that meets all our needs. The environment is eco-friendly, and all our laboratories are well-maintained with all the necessary equipment.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A good college to sharpen our brains and gain knowledge from well educated teachers .

review_content.Placements: About 45 to 50% of students were placed in my course. The highest package offered for my course was about 15lakhs per annum and the lowest was about 9lakhs per annum. Most AI integrated companies are the top recruiting companies for my course. Still I am not aware of internship as I am currently studying 1st year. But as far as I know, big companies have come across for internships. Data analysing is the major and top roles offered in my course.
review_content.Infrastructure: My department has free access to the Wi-Fi, it has a spacious and a big library for the students to explore more number of books and to develop their knowledge and all the classrooms have AC facilities. I am not an hosteler, am a days scholar student. Food quality is just up to the point and taste of the food is very good. Ramachandra is famous for medical. So medical facilities are also very good in this college. Importance for sports is great in my college.

review_summary.college_name: Guru Kashi University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is one of the best universities in Punjab to do the BCA course.

content.Placements: 70% of students in my course get selected. The highest package is 6.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. The average package ranges from 3-3.5 LPA. Honda and Tech Mahindra are the top companies that visit the college to hire students from my course. 60% of students got internships from my course in the HDFC Bank. The top role offered is a manager.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my department are excellent. It has a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility. There are many labs for different subjects. Classrooms are good. There is a huge library in which more than 500 students can study at one time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied by the mess food quality, roads, and the college life.

content.Placements: About 50 to 60% of students get placed in my course. The highest salary package offered is 15 LPA, and the average is 3.50 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, Kent, Nestled, etc. About 70 to 80% of the students get internships. Top roles are AI ML, and web development.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. Classrooms are also good, and Wi-Fi is available in hostel libraries. The hostel facilities is good, and the mess food quality is good in some hostels, and in some hostels it is bad. The sports tournament is held at our university every year. The canteen is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are more experienced and now there are new facilities.

content.Placements: Placements are not that enough. Around 2-3% of students got placements. The highest package is 30 LPA, and the minimum is 2 LPA. There are many companies like JU, Prabhat Seeds, etc. In this course, the top roles are to manage the agricultural field, pesticide distribution, safe use, and many banking jobs like assistant manager are there.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the course and the college are good as well. The labs and fields are there for better knowledge. Staff is also good but the new staff is just okay not that much good. Hostel looks good but I never lived in a hostel. The food of the hostel is not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Management - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a great college.

content.Placements: It is a great university where many students secure placements after finishing their studies. Last year, many students achieved about 100 out of 30-40. So, it is a nice university you can check out if you want to pursue a degree or master’s in any field.
content.Infrastructure: It has many buildings and departments according to different fields, and each department is very well maintained. There are plenty of canteens around the departments for lunch, as well as a library, computer lab, etc. It also has a park.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Best university in Punjab, and all faculty members are good.

content.Placements: 80% of students are placed here. The highest package here is 10 LPA, and the lowest package ranges from 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, and Amazon. Around 80% of students secure internships in companies like Microsoft, Deloitte, and startups.
content.Infrastructure: The department offers a well-equipped lab, Wi-Fi, best classroom, and a smart library with ample resources. Hostels have decent facilities including clean rooms, attached bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and study space. The mess food is average but hygienic. Medical facilities are available. Gym is also there.

paragraphs: Guru Kashi University has over 100 courses in 16 domains that are offered at the UG, PG, & PhD levels.

Guru Kashi University 2025- Admission Process
Find below the detailed process for Guru Kashi University admissions 2025:
1: Guru Kashi University Application Process 2025

Just so you know – the filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at Guru Kashi University. However, the application & entrance test fee will be paid online & candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the 2 copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
2: Selection Rounds
Admission to all the PG courses at Guru Kashi University is entrance-based.
3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After completing all the selection rounds, candidates must appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of the Guru Kashi University fee to secure their seats.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best universities in Punjab to do the BCA course.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my department are excellent. It has a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility. There are many labs for different subjects. Classrooms are good. There is a huge library in which more than 500 students can study at one time.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied by the mess food quality, roads, and the college life.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. Classrooms are also good, and Wi-Fi is available in hostel libraries. The hostel facilities is good, and the mess food quality is good in some hostels, and in some hostels it is bad. The sports tournament is held at our university every year. The canteen is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are more experienced and now there are new facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the course and the college are good as well. The labs and fields are there for better knowledge. Staff is also good but the new staff is just okay not that much good. Hostel looks good but I never lived in a hostel. The food of the hostel is not good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college.
reviews.review_text: It has many buildings and departments according to different fields, and each department is very well maintained. There are plenty of canteens around the departments for lunch, as well as a library, computer lab, etc. It also has a park.

reviews.review_heading: Best university in Punjab, and all faculty members are good.
reviews.review_text: The department offers a well-equipped lab, Wi-Fi, best classroom, and a smart library with ample resources. Hostels have decent facilities including clean rooms, attached bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and study space. The mess food is average but hygienic. Medical facilities are available. Gym is also there.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, but placement percentage is average.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best, and the buildings are superb. You can get free Wi-Fi, advanced labs, and a library here, but the classrooms are average not bad, but not the best. Hostels are good, and the food is also good. I was living in Shivalik Hostel, and that was awesome. Sports ground, medical facilities, and games, everything is good.

reviews.review_heading: The university is very good, the faculty is very good, but the placement is not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. There are two types of hostels, on-campus and off-campus. For off-campus hostels, two-seater and three-seater rooms are available. The campus has Wi-Fi, mess, and canteen facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and Supportive behaviour of the Staffs
reviews.review_text: Hostels are divided into three facilities :- A/C, Cooler, and fan. There are two playgrounds for the students to play. It is fully covered by wifi . Meals are awesome. Wardens are more supportive. There are central library, and many computer labs are available.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied because there is no good infrastructure, campus and management.
reviews.review_text:
Hostels are not good not bad, just average. 
But college infrastructure like labs and classrooms is not good, and sittings are also bad.
The main issue in summers is no proper fan working and in labs there is no AC.
In classrooms, there are only 5 fans, and strength of the students is 60.

reviews.review_heading: A glance of GKU. Faculty is very cooperative.
reviews.review_text: The labs are equipped with modern instruments but we rarely use them. Classes are normal at any school in the city. There is no air conditioning in classes. Wi-Fi facility only for faculty members. Projectors are there in some classrooms. The boys hostel rooms have attached washrooms, while the girls hostel does not. Average medical facilities are there. Mess food is very bad. Sports and game facilities are the best. Our university will rank 5th in Khelo, India, in 2023.

reviews.review_heading: If you have a budget above INR 4 lakhs for MBA, don't consider GKU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Classes are equipped with fans but no ACs. Yes, we have projectors in classrooms but no proper board for that. There is one smart lab & computer lab, but again with limited facilities. Yes, the quality of food in the hostel mess is good but rooms are overcrowded with 4 boys in a single room.

reviews.review_heading: Great Faculty and family-like College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our course, such as Books, Materials, Records, and Bluebooks for internals, we should pay for. In classrooms, there are Fans and Smart-TVs. The Library offers all facilities. Classrooms are large and spacious. The Hostel facilities are great. They offer more facilities, like food in the Mess. The quality of food in Mess is good. Medical facilities and many facilities. The Infrastructure of the College is good.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the faculty and facilities offered by the GKU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the GKU available for the MBA was good. The college had a pretty big and beautiful campus. Facilities like Wi-Fi, computers, labs, libraries, canteens, halls, auditoriums, etc. were given to the students. A hostel was available for the students of the college. The facilities offered at the college were above average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Guru Kashi University.
reviews.review_text: Many facilities are available in our classrooms with developed infrastructure. Digital classrooms are available with free Wi-Fi facilities. Many sports facilities are available in our college. The mess available in our college is good.

reviews.review_heading: It is a mind-blowing university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is mind-blowing. Hostel gives a homely feeling home. Food served in the mess is very good. Physical education is good. All the facilities are available in the mess. Doctor is available at the university. Library and computer lab are available.

individual_reviews.title: An Honest review of IITRAM, Ahmedabad.

content.Placements: As per my knowledge and last year's states, almost all those who applied for campus placement got it; however, most of them have been placed at a very low package of Rs. 5 lacs CTC per annum. AVG package: 5 LPA; the lowest: 2.5 LPA; the highest: 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Adani companies, Torrent Power, and some local Gujarat-based companies. However, other sorts of sports, like cricket and other sports, are organized on rented grounds.

faqs.question: Q: Who is eligible for Kaziranga University admission?

faqs.answer: No, you can't join Kaziranga University (KU) directly. Admission is based on merit and performance in entrance exams. For B.Tech and MBA admission, the university accepts admission on the basis of state or national level entrance exams such as: JEE, CEE, KUEST, CAT, GATE. Students can apply online and pay via credit card, debit card, or net banking. Kaziranga University is a state private university in Jorhat, Assam. It was founded in 2012 by the Assam Kaziranga University Act 2012. It is primarily a research university and affiliated with the UGC- University Grants Commission. The university offers 47 courses in five major fields.
faqs.question: Q: Can I join Kaziranga University - KU directly?

faqs.answer: Kaziranga University BSC application process can be completed in online or offline mode. Aspirants can submit an application form for BSc admission in one of the following three ways:Apply at the university: Candidates can visit the university campus or a registered office to collect the application form and prospectus by paying an application fee of INR 1,000Apply online: Candidates can visit the university's official website to fill out the application form and submit the application fee using debit card, credit card, or net bankingApply by post: Candidates can download the application form available on the university's official website. They must then send (via post) the duly filled application form to 'The Assam Kaziranga University, Koraikhowa, NH-37, Jorhat, 785006', along with a demand draft of INR 1,000
faqs.question: Q: Is BSc application process at Kaziranga University online or offline?

faqs.answer: For admission to different courses, Kaziranga University, located in Jorhat, Assam, has minimum score requirements. Students who want to major in math/biology, physics, or chemistry must receive at least 45% of their marks in their 10+2 exams. In the same way, the minimum percentage for B.Tech/B.E. and engineering programs is 50%. However, a marginally higher score of 50% is required for courses in science, business, and the arts. B.Com., B.Pharm., and bachelor's degree programs additionally need a minimum of 45% in order to be eligible. In order to add an extra layer of scrutiny to the admissions process, the university takes into account national entrance exams such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and Assam CEE for admission into specific courses.

faqs.question: What score is needed for admission to various courses offered at Kaziranga University?
faqs.answer: For admission to different courses, Kaziranga University, located in Jorhat, Assam, has minimum score requirements. faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in Kaziranga University for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: A stringent admissions process based on merit and performance on entrance exams is followed by Kaziranga University (KU). Prospective students interested in B.Tech and MBA programs must pass state or national entrance exams in order to be admitted. content.Placements: Approximately more than 60% students are getting placed by companies. Approximately 87% of the offers by placement companies are secured by our students. Pondicherry University offers UG, PG and Phd courses in Science, Arts, Management, Commerce, Law, Education, Social Sciences and other fields. These are offered by fourteen different schools, namely the School of Education, School of Mathematical Sciences and School of Humanities among others. Apart from this, the university runs a special programme, called Study India Programme (SIP) for international students. SIP offers both semester and short-term programmes only for international students based on the requirements of foreign universities.
While the flagship course of the University is MSc which is offered across different specialisations, other courses including MA, MBA, BA, and BSc are also popular at Pondicherry University. course_faqs.question: Is MCA available at Pondicherry University?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, Pondicherry University offers a three-year MCA programme spread over six semesters. The course is available at the Department of Computer Science of the Puducherry campus and at the Department of Computer Science of the Karaikal campus of Pondicherry University. A total of 125 seats are available combined at both campuses out of which 75 are available at the Puducherry campus while the remaining 50 are offered at the Karaikal campus.

overview_faqs.question: What is the application fee for MCA at Pondicherry University?
overview_faqs.answer: The application fee of MCA for all category candidates is INR 300. Students can pay the application fee online while registering for the course. In addition to the application and tiotion fee, there are several other components included in the overall fee structure for MCA. The details of the component-wise fee can be obtained from the official brochure, some of the components which are part of the overall MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund, medical examination/ facilities fund, library fund, computer lab fund, amenities development fund, students’ welfare fund and caution deposit (refundable), among various others. Read more about Pondicherry University MCA here.

overview_faqs.question: Does Pondicherry University provide Distance Education to the students?
overview_faqs.answer: Apart from the full-time programmes, the University offers distance education programmes in the field of Management, Commerce, Arts, Business Administration and more. Admission to all these programmes is done on the basis of merit.BBA and BCom are offered at the UG level. The course duration of both programmes is three years. Candidates who have done Class 12 can apply for these programmes. The final selection of students is based on the HSC scores.Apart from the UG programmes, the University offers three PG programmes under distance education. MCom, MA and MBA are offered with a course duration of two years. A candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant stream to be eligible for these programmes. The final selection of students will be based on the graduation scores.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Statistics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Pondicherry University is gorgeous.

content.Placements: Since there hasn't been any batch that has completed their graduation after the university started following the new NEP guidelines, there haven't been any placements made yet. Prior to the implementation of the NEP guidelines, the average package that students got from statistics was around 4 LPA-6 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities available right now have been used for a long time and haven't been updated yet in classrooms and labs. But the medical facilities are good, with proper canteens available across the campus. Wi-Fi provided is of good quality in certain places, reaching even up to 16 Mbps/sec.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Great place to study, but still, there is way more that can be improved.

content.Placements: The UG programme for our course has just started 2years back, so none of the batch has been placed yet. Though the Master's programme in this course has started long back, and the placements are below average, I feel. Not sure if the same applies to UG students as well.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is huge and spread across 800 acres. We have all the amenities, including all the required labs, proper classrooms for students, seminar halls, and conference rooms. Hostel mess provides hygienic and nutritious food all the 3 times a day. The menu is well planned, including a proper diet. We also have a health centre where health services are provided free of cost.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Material Science and Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Best for students who like the B.Tech and make connections with different countries students.

content.Placements: First of all, yours is the 2nd batch in this university. Before that, there was M. Tech for the last 2 years, and they started B.Tech, which is good. Coming to the placement part, it's quite good, not below average. Compared to other universities, this is a central university, so it's good in that case. I have no idea about the highest package place, but I have heard that the highest is 40 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Coming to facilities and infrastructure, it's very good for our department, which has a newly designed building with an AI sensor corridor light, which was used from 2015. The hostel is good with very well furnished rooms and the best maintenance and cleaning all around the campus, not only in the toilets. Mess food is good for what we are paying, like we are paying, and the canteen service is very good. Medical is next-level full fee, with well-maintained hygiene, and also 24/7. Sports and games are also available with very good grounds and a stadium.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a nice place to build our career.

content.Placements: Placements are quite good. My seniors are getting placed in Wabag, Chennai. Some other good companies also hire students. Packages offered are quite good for those who have nice company. For internships, faculty members will give permission to some of the popular institutes and industries.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. The network connection is quite poor, to be honest. We have library facilities. Our college conducts tournaments every year for all sports. Inter-college matches are available for all sports. The canteen food is below average.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Disaster Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: No placement. Friendly faculty members.

content.Placements: There is no placement after the course completion. We need to find our own jobs. After the completion of the course, you will get a Pondicherry University Certificate. After this course, learn any other skills like GIS, Python, etc. It will be helpful. Experience is required for a high-earning job in this field. Start from the DDMA, and we get a job.
content.Infrastructure: There is less equipment, and some equipment does not work properly. The department has one smartboard and Wi-Fi connection. There is a common library for the college. The food was average. The mess is contract-based, every year, it changes. Inside, there is a hostel committee and a campus committee, which conduct programmes, etc. There is a small ground in the hostel for throwball, cricket, football, etc.

faqs.question: Can I join Pondicherry University without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Admission to a majority of postgraduate and integrated postgraduate level courses at Pondicherry University is subject to CUET UG and CUET PG exams. In addition to this, the university also conducted the NCET exam for admission to its Integrated BA-B.Ed, Integrated BSc-B.Ed courses. Candidates seeking admission to Pondicherry University can apply for these exams and then apply to the university with a valid score.

faqs.question: Is BSc available in Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Pondicherry University offers a BSc programme with various courses spread across its affiliated colleges. The main campus of the university offers five-year MSc integrated courses for students wanting to pursue PG-integrated courses. Moreover, students seeking admission in regular three-year BSc courses can do so by applying at Pondicherry University’s affiliated colleges.

faqs.question: Does Pondicherry University provide Distance Education to the students?
faqs.answer: Apart from the full-time programmes, the University offers distance education programmes in the field of Management, Commerce, Arts, Business Administration and more. Admission to all these programmes is done on the basis of merit.BBA and BCom are offered at the UG level. The course duration of both programmes is three years. Candidates who have done Class 12 can apply for these programmes. The final selection of students is based on the HSC scores.Apart from the UG programmes, the University offers three PG programmes under distance education. MCom, MA and MBA are offered with a course duration of two years. A candidate must hold a bachelor’s degree in the relevant stream to be eligible for these programmes. The final selection of students will be based on the graduation scores.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: Under the BSc programme, Pondicherry University offers various specialisations. These specialisations are distributed amongst the university’s affiliated colleges. Thus, each course may have different eligibility criteria depending on the college. However, the common eligibility criterion is a pass in Class 12.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MCA at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: The application fee of MCA for all category candidates is INR 300. Students can pay the application fee online while registering for the course. In addition to the application and tiotion fee, there are several other components included in the overall fee structure for MCA. The details of the component-wise fee can be obtained from the official brochure, some of the components which are part of the overall MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund, medical examination/ facilities fund, library fund, computer lab fund, amenities development fund, students’ welfare fund and caution deposit (refundable), among various others. Read more about Pondicherry University MCA here .

faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Pondicherry University?
faqs.answer: The tuition fee for MBA at Pondicherry University is between INR 24,930 and INR 2.4 lakh . Students should also pay a registration fee of INR 300 while filling the application form. The aforementioned tuition fee is is indicative. Some of the components which are the part MBA course fee include registration fee, matriculation fee, sports fund and development fund.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for Pondicherry University BSc course?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for Pondicherry University BSc courses is INR 1,100 to 1.1 lakh as per official sources. However, it is still subject to changes. Hence, it is, indicative. Apart from this, the fee structure for Pondicherry University courses contains various other fee components such as Registration & Processing Fee, Study Material & Handling Charges, Matriculation Fee, etc. Students are advised to visit the official site of the university to find out the detailed fee structure.

reviews.review_heading: A college that offers you academics, sports, and tech.

reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-furnished and fully air-conditioned. The entire campus is connected with Wi-Fi. The library facility is also great. Hostels are not less than any 3-star hotel. The campus is so beautiful that a person gets to delve into it. I would rate 5 out of 5 for the food. It has one of the best food services someone can have in a mess. However, the college lacks proper medical facilities. It has a weekly visiting qualified doctor. The institute has newly built sports areas, for differen...

reviews.review_heading: Really very beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: We have separate labs for electronics and computers and have all sports equipment and a beautiful ground with an athletics track around it. Our hostel rooms are some of the most beautiful rooms. They have everything: a bed, a study table, a spring mattress, and a cupboard, which are beautifully designed. We have Wi-Fi facilities all over the campus and the campus is well connected with Diu City because of the city bus. Our hostel warden has also allotted a vehicle to the students for any emergen...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the hostel, but facilities are bad.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very slow, but the hostel rooms are good. Classrooms and labs are okay; some labs do not have sufficient components in the EC. The mess food is average, but it is too oily. There is no canteen now. For medical facilities, a doctor comes to campus once or twice every 2 to 3 weeks. The sports facilities are good, but the number of table tennis courts is very low.

reviews.review_heading: Reasons why you should come to IIIT VADODARA.
reviews.review_text: The best part about our college which makes it different from the other IIITs is it’s hostel and academic infrastructure. Being newly established, the hostel rooms and its furnitures are completely well maintained and are in a good condition. Also, there are water coolers at each floor which is a convenience for all the students.

reviews.review_heading: A newly built Campus with lots of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are very good with having all facilities and 24x7 Wi-Fi Facility in academic block with no restrictions. You can use classrooms also for studies till midnight. There are 2 huge libraries in campus. Hostels are well - setup with all the facilities and the rooms as compared to other IIIT's are very nice. Currently there is only one branch (CSE), but may be in future you may SEE other branches too. The mess is currently managed by a private body (Jaiswal Canteens) and quality of food is ...

reviews.review_heading: Our college is newly built satellite campus which is awesome for campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is top-notch. Campus is endowed with Wi-Fi 24x7 and classrooms are open for studies. Library, canteen, and other facilities are perfectly taken care. Food in mess is awesome. There is a mess committee to decide the menu for the mess, and the chefs make delicious food. There are major sports facilities and sports equipment. There is football, cricket ground, basketball court, lawn tennis, table tennis, and much more. There is a government sports academy nearby which has all other f...

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements, hostel, and infrastructure but it is costly.
reviews.review_text: Hostel premises are very good but costly. Rajlabdhi Society is the current hostel for IIITV. There are flats of 2 BHK for 5 persons and 3 BHK for 7 persons available for students. Mess is joined with a hostel around 100 m at the backside. Girls have one completely different building in the same society with proper guard and protection. The hostel does not have Wi-Fi facility. You have to arrange on your own.

reviews.review_heading: It has good facilities, excellent placements in 2020, good faculty and located in a beautiful place.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also good here, and many facilities are available here. There are two huge libraries and a good Wi-Fi facility on the campus. Classrooms and labs are designed very well. This is a new IIIT, so there is only one branch (CSE), but in future, you can see more branches. But until now, the college was not open due to the COVID-19 pandemic, so I don't have information about gymkhana, canteen, mess and hostels. I visited there with my friend to see the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure-wise college has good facilities, but its main drawback is the placement opportunitie
reviews.review_text: IIIT-VICD is a modern campus with all essential facilities like Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, gym, and the campus is very clean with two people for one room in a hostel. For games, a cricket ground, football, volleyball, basketball, and tennis courts are available. The quality of food in the mess is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, good hostel life, good sports ground.
reviews.review_text: In this college, the positive things are its food and infrastructure. The Wi-Fi may sometimes not work, but regarding infrastructure, we have a cricket, basketball, volleyball, football, and tennis ground. We also have a TT table that is open at 12 o'clock.

review_summary.college_name: R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology - RVSCET Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty, good placements in 2015.

content.Placements: Only 30 percent of students get placed in companies like Adhunik, Codestam Technology. Around 50-60 percent of students get internship from our course, and the highest package offered by companies is 5-6 LPA, and minimum package around 2-4 LPA offered by companies like TCS, Adhunik, Codestam Technology, and many more.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department are not bad. We have a good classroom, a good library, labs, and also Wi-Fi. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is okay. There are separate hostels for boys and girls. The food available in the mess and canteen is not so good, but the medical and sports or games facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Affiliated by the government (JUT), excellent in infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Approximately 70% of students get placed. The highest package is 8 LPA, the average package is 6 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Recruiters like Tata Motors, Nathcorp, and Tech Mahindra are available for the EEE course. Roles offered in my course include GET and junior engineer positions. All students have to do internships in companies like Apex Auto, IDTR, etc.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi for students. Labs are according to the daily routine. The infrastructure in labs is good. The library is free for all books and is free for first 15 days, after Rs.2 fine per day. Classrooms are good, with hi-fi classrooms for BCA students. A mess is available. Volleyball, cricket, and all kinds of sports are available. There is no gym.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Not good to take admission here and don't expect for a good placement.

content.Placements: We got companies like BPO and small start-ups which want us to sign an agreement for 5 years for low packages. They organize placement drives which are not useful. The college only invites a few companies which only hire students of the web development field, so the students from other domains don't have to hope for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure is good, but they put three students in a single room, which is small for three people living. The classrooms are old school type, with blackboards and chalk. The important thing is the computer labs, in which the computers are not working properly and are too old versions.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely Dissatisfied Because of Hostel, Really Good Campus and Facilities

content.Placements: 60-70% of students were able to secure placements through campus drives. The highest package is 6.5 LPA, the lowest was 2.1 LPA, and the average package is 3.5 LPA for the course. Top recruiters include Tata Motors, Nathcorp, etc. Additionally, 90% of students get internships through the college, with roles such as software developers, managers, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in the college are average, including big classrooms, some equipped with smart boards and air conditioning, along with labs and a library. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is average, similar to other colleges. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is also average, and medical facilities are available on campus. All sports and games are accessible on campus.

faqs.question: What B.Tech specialisations are available at R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology provides a BTech in six specialisations such as Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Metallurgical Engineering.The programmes are intended to ensure that students are well endowed with technical know-how.B.Tech is a 3-4 year course.The students are free to make the choice according to their interest and career choice.

faqs.question: How is admission granted for B.Tech at R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: The admission process to the B.Tech course offered at R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology is simply based on merit.The candidates are chosen on the basis of their class 12 results or the pass score of the admissions tests given.It does not need to have a separate institutional test.The seat allotment is final taking into account eligibility and verification of documents.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the B.Tech course at R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: The duration of B.Tech programme at the R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology is 3 to 4 years basing on the entry requirements.Regular students undergo a complete 4 mad course whereas Diploma holders can be absorbed in the 2 and year through lateral entry.The course of study is suitable to both industry demands and academic requirements.

faqs.question: What is the duration and focus area of the MCA programme at R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology?
faqs.answer: The R.V.S College of Engineering and Technology offers MCA programme as a three year postgraduate programme.It specialises in IT and Software and provides in depth training in programming, database maintenance and application development.The programme equips the students to work in the technological field.It is attached to the Kolhan University.

reviews_list.review_title: Great placements, hackathons, and placement training.

review_content.Placements: There are almost 100% placements. The highest package is around 32 LPA, the lowest is around 3–4 LPA, and the average package is around 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters are Dell, Mercedes Benz, Visa, Amazon, etc. Around 200 6th-semester students are doing summer internships, and all 7th-semester students have internship offers, mostly in Bangalore. The top roles offered are SDE and others.
review_content.Infrastructure: Labs for ECE include VLSI, Robotics, AR/VR, Advanced Communication, NI LabVIEW Academic School, DST Curri Lab, IoT Lab, and Skill Lab. Classrooms are separate for all sections. The library also has a digital library, and Wi-Fi is available in the library and labs. I am a day scholar, so I do not know much about the hostel, but we have a good canteen and cafeteria. Sports facilities are also great. Many students play at district and state levels. There are also sports and games competitions during our techno-cultural fest in the even semester. We have on-campus accident insurance of 1 lakh for students and a tie-up with Aditya Adhikari Hospital for any medical emergencies.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers good facilities and great faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with a good library, Wi-Fi facility, good laboratories and common rooms for both boys and girls. But the classrooms lack some basic facilities like proper ventilation, projector and white screen, which are necessary in today's world.

reviews.review_heading: A college which offer great memories. A campus worth studying.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of GEC is old, but it is maintained very well. The campus is spread over more than 1000 acres. There are separate buildings for the accounts section where the fee payment transactions can be done and an academic section where they operate academic works. We even have our own power substation.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college. Overall, the college provides good exposure.

reviews.review_heading: GEC is good for the overall development, and it teaches you a lot more than just engineering.
reviews.review_text: The campus is sprawling over 150 acres. Currently, it houses IIT Goa which should give aspirants a clear idea of the area on hand. admission_process.title: K.S. Group of Institutions Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Admission toK.S. Group of Institutionsis based on entrance. The Institute offers these courses at the UG, PG, and Diploma levels. The Institute offers respective courses based on valid scores of accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, and KCET etc. K.S. Group of Institutions application process commences online through the official website of the institute or the government body, such as COMEDK. Listed below is a step-by-stepK.S. Group of Institutions admission processexplained below:
1: Application & Registration

Students must visit the official website of theK.S. Group of Institutionsto fill out the application form. Candidates must fill the necessary details to confirm candidature and submit the form along with application fees.
2: Entrance Exams

Admission to several UG level courses is based on valid scores obtained in UGCET exam. Whereas, for courses such as BTech, candidates must secure valid score in accepted national or state level entrance exams such as JEE Main, UGET, GATE, NATA, etc.
3: Selection Criteria

Students are selected on the basis of either the national or state-level entrance exam scores, followed by counselling (if required). The institute also offers seats via management quota. At the time of application, students need to provide scores obtained in the above-mentioned entrance exams, based on which selection will be made.
4: Admission Confirmation
Selected students need to pay theK.S. Group of Institutions' feesto secure their spots at the institute.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Law (LL.B.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Best law college in Delhi NCR.

content.Placements: Students got placement in around 90 percent. All students are satisfied with the course placement. The highest package is 40 LPA but the average is 6 LPA. Internship rate is impressive, and 99 percent are from college. The roles of Lawyers are in a top position. Almost everyone got a placement and an internship opportunity.
content.Infrastructure: Moot courts for practice and experts are invited from outside for the real-world experiences. All necessary facilities are available at the campus only, so we do not need to go outside for small item purchases. Library access is 16 hours a day. We have in house ambulance, our Nescafé and café 14 is the best café we have in-house.

individual_reviews.course: BBA. LLB - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My experience at Geeta Institute of Law, Geeta University.

content.Placements: Almost all eligible students are in good places today. GIL assist well in placements. The highest package here is 36 LPA. Companies like Accenture are ones where students are placed. All eligible students got an opportunity for placements. It is good overall.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is good, airy, and it is also clean and green, located in a good place with nice surroundings. All labs and the library are well-equipped. Classrooms have smart boards. Food is good here at the mess. Food cafes are also good here. The hostel is fine here.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Fine college and placements.

content.Placements: Placement percentage is fine. Some students get placed in sales and some get placed in product-based companies. The highest package is 9 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are mostly TCS, Pronell, Prodesk, Agrosoft, and many more. Top roles offered are front-end developer and back-end developer.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is fine sometimes it works, sometimes it does not. The labs are also fine. Classrooms have AC in them, and they are spacious. The library is filled with books but its small. Hostel is fine as I heard from the hostellers as I am a day scholar. The food in mess and canteen is fine.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) (Hons.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am enjoying the vibrant atmosphere at Geeta University.

content.Placements: The number of placements was decent in my course. At least 80–90 percent got placements, and others opted for higher studies or went abroad to pursue their career in higher studies. Top recruiting companies that came to the campus included Wipro, TCS, HTL Ltd., and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and amenities provided at the campus were much better than what I observed in other institutes. Rather than just providing the best services, they maintained hygiene on the campus, in the mess, and in the classrooms as well. Here, I found the campus catered to services.

Students are selected based on several parameters including their past academic performance, entrance exam scores (if applicable), and more. Candidates willing to apply forGeeta University admission 2025are required to apply online by visiting the university's official website. If you want to know more about theGeeta University admission process 2025read the following article.

reviews.review_heading: Appreciate the campus and curriculum.

reviews.review_heading: My best time is learning and exploring.

A lot of diligence had been done in maintaining every classroom, lab, and especially the library, which was my favourite. I like to visit day in and day out here. The newspapers-reading area was well-maintained and very calm to sit. The hostel food was my favourite. What I like the most is snack time.

reviews.review_heading: I am really satisfied with the curriculum and college life. I learnt a lot during my internships.

reviews.review_heading: It has excellent core academics with vibrant campus life.

The class can accommodate almost 35-40 students.

reviews.review_heading: Geeta University: A good mix of learning and opportunities.
reviews.review_text: I would rate the course as fairly good. The mentorship is provided by Coding Clock mentors, and they teach really well. The labs are glass labs with 50–60 seats of capacity per lab, and there is fast Wi-Fi in every lab and classroom. However, there is no seminar hall in our CSE department.

reviews.review_heading: This college is allrounder. It provides you everything good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available. Labs were good. Library was excellent, where you could study peacefully. Gym was also available where you could work on your personality. Hostel facility was awesome. I will never complain about this. It was a good budget friendly college that provided you good skills with placement.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good teachers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, labs are good, classrooms are good, and the library is good. I was a day scholar, but I heard the hostel was good. The food at the mess is fine, not like home, but fine. There are 3 canteens, medical facilities are available, and all types of sports and games are available.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, good hostel.

The academy infrastructure is very good.

The mess and canteen feedback is generally positive, with people mentioning that the meals are decent.

overview_faqs.question: Is MBA available at Apex University?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, Apex University offers full-time Master of Business Administation or MBA pogramme. The duration of the PG-level programme is two years. In addition to popular MBA specialisations, such as Marketing, Finance, HRM, etc., the university provides various new-age MBA specialisations, such as Digital Marketing, Agribusiness Management, Business Analytics, etc. Admission to these courses are entrance-based. The university allocates 50% of the total seats based on the CUET merit. The remaining 50% seats are filled through the APEX merit of the university.

overview_faqs.question: Is BCom available at Apex University?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, BCom is available at Apex University. It is a UG-level programme offered in the full-time mode. In addition to the BCom (General), the university offers BCom (Hons) in two specialisations. These courses are BCom (Hons) in Strategic Finance (affiliated with USCMA) and BCom (Hons) in International Accounting & Finance (affiliated with ACCA). These courses are offered through the university's School of Commerce & Management. The duration of these courses is three years. Interested candidates can visit the university's official website to apply/enquire about the programme.

review_summary.college_name: Apex University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Full Stack - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Apex College in Jaipur is the best option, but for better placement, you can choose another.

content.Placements: I am from the Computer Science batch at Apex College. In our passing-out batch, 85% of students were successfully placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, the lowest is 3.2 LPA, and the average package stands at around 5.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, and Capgemini.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course at Apex College is fairly decent. The classrooms are clean and equipped with projectors. Wi-Fi is available across the campus, though it is sometimes slow. Labs are well-maintained, with the basic software and hardware required for practicals.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Everything went well at the university.

content.Placements: You will get a good placement, along with that, you will be given the facility of an internship from time to time. If you want to increase your knowledge well and you will also get a good package. You can get an LPA package from 2 LPA to 5 LPA from Apex University.
content.Infrastructure: You will be taught and educated in an AC room. There is a computer lab. There is also a library and along with that you are provided with internet facility. The food in the mess is also good. You will also get a canteen in the college. Sports and games are also played.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Data Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty and college facilities are good.

content.Placements: The percentage of student placements is around 60% in my course. The highest package is around 9.3 LPA and the lowest is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho. Around 70% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Apex University in Jaipur, Rajasthan offers a wide range of facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, mess, and canteen. It also maintains a hygienic environment around the college campus and is a tobacco-free zone.

individual_reviews.course: B.Ed. Special Education in Intellectual Development Disability) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: There were 30 seats in my course, and all seats were filled by students. Basically, in this course, there were no placement offers. Teachers trained us on how to teach in schools and child care centers and how to deal with special needs children, so no placement was required for this course.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms were well-furnished and equipped. Wi-Fi was available in the library. Hostel food was good in taste and served fresh. The mess and canteen maintained hygiene. Medical facilities were good, and the university organized clubs and tournaments on campus for sports and other activities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Only the faculty members are good and events are awesome.

content.Placements: In pharmacy, the percentage of replacement is very low and it's 30%. Students only get the marketing job in the placement drive. No good industrial companies come for placements. In my course, the college provides good companies for internships. It guides and fully helps in internships.
content.Infrastructure: I am not in the hostel so I don't know about the hostel. My friend lives in the college hostel and according to them, it's good. I don't like the classrooms.
content.Faculty: Faculty members are very good. The teaching quality is good. All teachers are PhD holders. The course curriculum is relevant. We have industry visits which help with the knowledge of industries and practical work. Semester exams are fine, and the pass percentage is 70% in college. It is a 4-year long course. The study is good in college.

Candidates must have a BE/BTech or equivalent degree in the concerned stream with 50% of marks. Admission will be based on merit entirely on the performance of the candidate in GATE.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for M.Tech at ACS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: To be considered for M.Tech at ACS College of Engineering, applicants should have a BE/BTech or equivalent degree. At least 50% marks in the concerned engineering stream are needed. Only candidates who meet this academic requirement can apply for admission.

faqs.question: Can I get M.Tech admission in ACS College of Engineering without a GATE score?
faqs.answer: No, ACS College of Engineering needs a valid GATE score for admission to MTech. Candidates will not be considered for the selection process if they do not clear GATE. It is necessary to prepare and clear GATE to get a seat in M.Tech in ACS.

faqs.question: Are there any seat reservations at ACS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: Yes, If You Apply Through COMEDK or KCET at ACS College of Engineering. Seat reservation Followed by the COMEDK or KCET Same will Be Followed By College. But no seat reservation for Management Quota Students.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at ACS College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: Direct admission to ACS College of Engineering is not available. All admissions are made through the entrance exam and interview process. However, you can get direct admission at ACS College of Engineering if you have a valid score in the KCET or COMEDK entrance test. You can also apply through the management quota, but the fee will be higher. You can fill out the online application form on their website or contact them by phone or email.

reviews.review_heading: Poor college, don't join this college at all, every placement and good education is a drama here.
reviews.review_text: Our college has average library, and some toilets are not at all clean. But the main principal and CSE floor toilets are well maintained. Rest toilets are not clean at all, mainly the library. They have not cleaned at all in years. Please avoid this, the worst college at any cost and save your precious time.

reviews.review_heading: This college gives us a degree with no skills.
reviews.review_text: Labs are average. Wi-Fi is available but doesn't connect or work properly. Hostel food is below average. The library is average. The canteen is below average, and there is no proper hygienic food in the canteen. Classrooms are average with a decent place for students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of ACS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The food provided for hostellers is good. The lecturers mentioned during the admission process that they would provide Wi-Fi for every student, but we still haven’t received the password. Additionally, the laboratories are not well-equipped; some systems are not in working condition, and overall, the labs need improvement.

reviews.review_heading: Above Average as placements are guaranteed, faculty is excellent with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms, and every week, we are taken to the hospital (starting from the 5th semester), and the doctors and biomedical engineers explain how they use the equipment in real-time. Medical facilities are excellent because it is beside a hospital, but the food quality in the hostel is below average. Students constantly fall sick; sometimes, insects are found in the food, mainly in the girls' hostel. In the boys' hostel, the food is a little above average. Sports and games...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the infrastructure and good faculty support in the entire course.
reviews.review_text:
Good campus with a green environment around and very vast sections for sports and other physical activities, a good spacious classroom, and 3 canteens present on the campus. 
Hostel and mess are average but good support in sports and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for engineering in ECE courses according to my experience in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Good faculty and infrastructure are available for our course. College Wi-Fi is also available, along with labs, classrooms, and the library. Hostel facilities are very nice, and the quality of food is average in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities, sports, and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Life at college was always good. Really good infrastructure and a well-maintained campus .
reviews.review_text: The college facilities are very good and it is a Wi-Fi-enabled campus with a good atmosphere. The college includes a lab for each department. Mechanical, aerospace and aeronautical labs are under ground. Faculty members are good and friendly with students .

reviews.review_heading: ACS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the college infrastructure is good and above average for a college like this. Lab facilities for aerospace engineering are good along with lawns being available. Hostel is also good. The food options may vary depending on what you prefer to eat. The college hostel has well-equipped rooms available in double and triple sharing occupancy.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing ACS college of engineering.
reviews.review_text: There is an available of college Wi-Fi along with well furnished labs for each department in our college. College library contains good informative books which we can borrow to read. The college provides hostel facilities for the students who come from far off places. Sports are also organized every year.

reviews.review_heading: Review of ACS College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Laboratory is well-equipped. It has a central library on the top floor of the college. Hostel rooms are very good and spacious. It has a gym facility. The food served in the mess is not good. There is a huge playground on campus. Wi-Fi is available. Basketball, volleyball, and badminton courts are available. Football and cricket grounds are available.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. Laboratory is well-equipped. There is a central library along with departmental library. Hostel is also very good. We also have a good gym facility. Mess food quality is bad. There is a big playground with basketball court, badminton court, volleyball court, football ground and cricket ground. The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty, good placements in 2022, good infrastructure, and facilities.
reviews.review_text: They provide very good facilities and infrastructure for all the branches and courses. There are well-equipped labs and good classrooms. The hostel is clean, and the quality of food is good. Snacks will be given in the evening.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and good faculty members. It had good placements in 2021.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Students get Wi-Fi facilities, and classrooms are kept clean. Each branch is provided with a lab as per requirement. The library has a good collection of books related to the subjects of each branch, which is helpful for students.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied. Good placement and training even though it was covid times .
reviews.review_text: College had an average infrastructure. But kept on increasing day by day. Whatever students asked, the necessities were provided. Labs were well-equipped according to vtu standards. Medical facilities were available as it is in the medical campus. We were given opportunities in sports too.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with all facilities. Average placement happens here.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure with all facilities. Wi-Fi is available. Labs are well taught. Nice class room with projector. Very big library with digital place also. Good and neat canteen with different types food. Hostel mess is nice. Near by hospital is there for medical facilities.

college_info.intro:
Newton School of Technology offers a four-year, full-time, residential programme at the UG level. The BTech programme is offered in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) in collaboration with the Ajeenkya DY Patil University.
The institute offers a dynamic curriculum with a focus on developing practical skills among the students in the fields of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. Newton School of Technology also offers paid internship opportunities to students in top-tech companies such as NumFOCUS, Mudrex, and MoveInSync, among others. Additionally, the institute provides students with an opportunity to meet top CXOs and leaders from Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and other leading companies. Newton School of Technology also organises fully-funded international conferences and study trips for students, to expose them to global industry trends and help them with networking opportunities. Below are some of the most popular Newton School of Technology ADYPU courses, along with eligibility and selection criteria:

Newton School of Technology also offers a placement assistance programme to students. The programme helps students with resume building and interview preparation. During the recent placement drive conducted by the institute, the highest and average packages offered to students stood at INR 64 LPA and INR 12 LPA, respectively. reviews.review_heading: Amazing facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar. The department is providing top facilities in classrooms and labs.  The library has all the reference textbooks for each subject. The hostels are providing good facilities for students. I heard that the food is good in the canteen. Necessary medical, sports, and game facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching quality, but average placements and limited campus space.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is average because the campus is relatively small. It does not have much open space. Only a few classrooms and labs receive stable Wi-Fi, while the remaining rooms have very slow speeds. Mobile signals drop inside the campus. Classrooms are clean. Smartboards and projectors work properly. Most labs are in good condition. Faculty is renovating the obsolete ones. The library is calm and well-stocked. Friends say hostel rooms are neat. The food is good, though fully...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college provides the best facilities and infrastructure for the students with sufficient labs, classrooms, library. The college also provides hostel facilities which are also quite. The college hostel provides excellent food and co-curricular activities for the students.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, but the university is not good enough.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the department is very good. All classrooms have Wi-Fi availability, and labs are really useful. But the hostel facility is an average and also the canteen. In 4 years, students are passing through various subjects that will help them in the future.

reviews.review_heading: A college with good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are good labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel is better than the others. It provides a gym facility and a ground. The old canteen was bad. The new one is better and has better food. There is a huge football ground, cricket nets, volleyball court, and basketball court. Inside the hostel, there is a badminton court.

reviews.review_heading: As a beginner, I am currently satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: One of the main specialities of our college is its infrastructure. There are a lot of amenities and facilities both inside and outside the campus area. There is a vending machine for refreshments, which is not common in other colleges. Within the department, there is also a startup mission lab for the students to light up their ideas. As I am a day scholar, I am not informed about the hostel facility. But the college infrastructure is one of the most highlighted parts.

reviews.review_heading: Experienced college review.
reviews.review_text: The college has a great infrastructure. It has a central library for everyone. Also, each department has its own libraries. Each classroom is advanced and contains Wi-Fi accessible to the students. Hostel is arranged near the college building. MS is handled by the students and the staff. Food available in the canteen is of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Adi Shankara Institute of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure and facilities for our course. They provide labs for the students and high-quality equipment for the experiments. They provide us with free Wi-Fi in every corner of the college. There is a library for every department and also a main library at the center hall.

reviews.review_heading: ASIET is good if you want to focus on both enjoying yourself and studying.
reviews.review_text: There is a lab for the practical sessions. The college provides wi-fi connections for classes. There is a library too and the infrastructure is also good at our college. The hostel facilities are okay and the canteen food is not that impressive at college. But overall, the college is good.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college, which has a good ambience, good facilities, infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities for students are available. A Wi-Fi network is available for the students. Lab facilities for doing projects, etc., are also provided by the college. A large library is also available, where students can go anytime and take books and refer to them.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: Campus is fully equipped with free Wi-Fi. And also, good labs are there; libraries are there with wide varieties of books; books are arranged topic-wise, making it easy for us to find the required books; and online PDFs are also available on the library website. Classrooms are equipped with projectors and each department has its own Wi-Fi system.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in Eranakulam.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and features in classrooms are great as every classroom has wifi and projectors. Labs are also well-maintained and have powerful machines. The food in the hostel is not that good as the college is vegetarian, only vegetarian food is available in the hostel and in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Adi shankara can give you a college life that you wish.
reviews.review_text: Campus infrastructure is a 9/10. The college offers excellent advanced labs and technologies for all kinds of studies. The campus is divided into blocks where each block is very much well-maintained. Wi-Fi network is available for all the students and staffs with high-speed internet. The college also offers you required support in sports and arts. There is a medical room where you can rest.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the course.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus is very good. The environment around the campus is very nice. There are 3 labs for the Department of Artificial Intelligence and about twenty to thirty faculty members for teaching. The canteen is very clean, and the food is very tasty. Every year, the college conducts sports and arts festivals.

reviews.review_heading: Best in class for your bright future with placements, infrastructure and academics.
reviews.review_text: At the first look of the infrastructure, you will see the engineering design from the entrance itself. There are mainly 4 main blocks which are separated from each other. The main office building has EEE, ECE and CS AI branches, and in a separate building alone, mechanical branch is there. There is another separate building for civil and biomedical branches. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled which is available for the students also. The hostel being inside the campus compound is the best part. O...
